style: Premium, modern, and calm visual language built from precise geometric primitives, soft-rounded edges, and subtle material layering; flat by default with a restrained 5–8% vertical luminance shift for depth, thin clean outlines, and crisp occlusion shadows (8–12 px blur, 10–15% opacity) that sit close to objects. Surfaces are matte and paper-like, envelopes feel like neatly folded card with micro-bevels, and budget bars read as smooth acrylic chips. Lighting is soft frontal-ambient with faint top falloff; no harsh gloss, no skeuomorphism. Composition favors balanced negative space, centered heroes, and gentle motion cues implied by hover/stacking. Mood is focused, adult, and trustworthy; color accents are sparing (emerald for success, amber for caution) against slate/navy neutrals to maintain WCAG contrast and harmony with the UI.
